tables.name: aml_analysis_publications
tables.purpose: Atomic visibility fence for derived outputs; stale source snapshots remain auditable but invisible.

columns.name: network_id
columns.description: Network scope of this analysis publication.

columns.name: family
columns.description: cluster, exposure or risk output family.

columns.name: publication_id
columns.description: run_id or assessment_id; never reused for a different output revision.

columns.name: source_revision
columns.description: Exact chain publication fence used for all source reads.

columns.name: as_of_block
columns.description: Canonical block at which the source analysis was evaluated.

columns.name: output_revision
columns.description: Exact immutable output-row revision sealed by this publication.

columns.name: status
columns.description: complete or invalidated; latest status wins before visibility filtering.

columns.name: row_counts_json
columns.description: Exact output family row counts checked before publication.

columns.name: created_at_unix_ms
columns.description: Audit timestamp; never used as a source validity epoch.

views.name: aml_sync_state_current
views.purpose: Latest whole publication row before state predicates; no older initialized fence may reappear.
views.select: SELECT network_id, data.1 AS revision, data.2 AS initialized, data.3 AS start_block, data.4 AS last_block_number, data.5 AS last_block_hash, data.6 AS observed_rpc_height, data.7 AS published_at_unix_ms, data.8 AS source_cursor_json FROM (SELECT network_id,argMax(tuple(revision,initialized,start_block,last_block_number,last_block_hash,observed_rpc_height,published_at_unix_ms,source_cursor_json),revision) AS data FROM {{database}}.aml_sync_state GROUP BY network_id)

views.name: aml_ingested_blocks_canonical
views.purpose: Latest complete canonical marker inside the published observed range; rollback markers prevent resurrection.
views.select: SELECT network_id, block_number, data.1 AS block_hash, data.2 AS block_timestamp_unix_ms, data.3 AS commit_id, data.4 AS revision, data.5 AS parent_hash, data.6 AS canonical, data.7 AS ingestion_status, data.8 AS transaction_count, data.9 AS receipt_coverage, data.10 AS trace_coverage, data.11 AS prevout_coverage, data.12 AS source_id, data.13 AS created_at_unix_ms, data.14 AS expected_counts_json, data.15 AS raw_evidence_json FROM (SELECT b.network_id AS network_id, b.block_number AS block_number, argMax(tuple(b.block_hash, b.block_timestamp_unix_ms, b.commit_id, b.revision, b.parent_hash, b.canonical, b.ingestion_status, b.transaction_count, b.receipt_coverage, b.trace_coverage, b.prevout_coverage, b.source_id, b.created_at_unix_ms, b.expected_counts_json, b.raw_evidence_json), b.revision) AS data,any(s.last_block_number) AS fence_tip,any(s.last_block_hash) AS fence_hash FROM {{database}}.aml_ingested_blocks AS b INNER JOIN {{database}}.aml_sync_state_current AS s ON b.network_id=s.network_id WHERE s.initialized=1 AND b.revision<=s.revision AND b.block_number>=s.start_block AND b.block_number<=s.last_block_number GROUP BY b.network_id,b.block_number) WHERE data.6=1 AND data.7='complete' AND (block_number<fence_tip OR data.1=fence_hash)
